title: Hatsune Miku — Miku Miku ☆ Gunner!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm back, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Emu!
Did you find the thing?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! It's right here!
Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What is that? It looks like a camera...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, is it one of those cameras that immediately prints out the photos you take?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, it's an instant camera?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Correct!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We can take pictures using this and doodle on them together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here! I even brought a bunch of pens for us to use♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Now I see.
This is pretty close to what we did.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, Miku, you were whispering to her about...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I asked her about this camera♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You really are a genius, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. Although, you had me a little worried when you shouted just now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You specifically said, “I remember now!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! Remember that meeting we had a while ago when Phoenix Wonderland was in big trouble?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I had Emu show me her idea notebook that time☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One of those ideas was “taking commemorative photos with the mascots and receiving the actual photos from them”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We didn't end up using that idea, but I had an instant camera ready for it and decided to go fetch it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. Now it all makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does this mean we get to take pictures and doodle on them together?!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len & MEIKO
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Even you seem happy about this, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's because I was curious about it as well!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, I might try actually taking some photos!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna try that too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me three!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, don't forget me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
We can take lots and lots of pictures!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Then, I'll take the first one!
Gather up for me, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We may need to get fairly cozy if we all want to fit into the frame.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In that case! Squeeeeze!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha! Miku, stop!
It tickles when you rub your cheek up against mine!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Ready, everyone?!
Say, “Cheese!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mhm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, Luka, you dozed off and fell out of the frame! I only got half of you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. It really is exactly half of her. This one might actually be pretty fun to doodle on.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! Let's keep taking more and more pictures!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Next, it's doodling time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu brought over a bunch of pens for us, so feel free to use whichever you like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Woohoo! This is what I've been waiting for♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Doodle-doodle. Whoosh-whoosh. Spinny-spin♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa...! She's drawing all over hers without a second thought!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. This photo's becoming more and more festive by the second.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're not gonna let her have all the fun! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If you'd like, KAITO, you should try doodling too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you sure? Well, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Emu, Nene, join us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
C'mon, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not exactly the best artist out there, but since we're all doodling together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay! We get to have a doodling party!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Emu
rows.Line: Hahahahaha!
